title: shorea megistophylla
intro: Shorea megistophylla, commonly known as Balau or Burmese Teak, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its wood, which is highly prized for its durability and resistance to rot and insects. The health benefits of Shorea megistophylla include its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
